summary.text: Dawne Shand is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Essex District who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a writer by profession and defeated Stephen Roth in the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Dawne Shand earned a bachelor's degree in economics and French from the University of Alabama in 1992 and a master's degree in creative nonfiction from Emerson College in 2005.
Her career experience includes working as a writer, serving as campaign manager of Jamie Zahlaway Belsito's 2020 congressional campaign, and serving as director of The Tannery Series.
Shand assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Republican James Kelcourse.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the joint committees on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets; Cannabis Policy; Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture; and Health Care Financing.
